title: Planet Tweaks V2.8.2 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — $10k Liquid Glass Settings, Supabase Cloud Auth, Sprint-Macro Freedom & Sub-Tab Architecture

Supabase Cloud Sync: Instant 1-click cloud sync and Google OAuth fallback with encrypted cloud persistence. Sprint Macro Engine: Shift key restrictions completely removed so tactical sprint never stops or interrupts custom macro sequences. Precision Mouse Polling: Upgraded polling rate measurement to a sliding window queue for rock-solid 1000Hz/4000Hz/8000Hz esports accuracy. GPU Spec Switcher: Comprehensive display key spoofing and WinSAT string coverage. Random Sub-Tabs & Restore Point Controls: Organized Random tab into 4 dedicated sub-tabs with foldable restore point lists.
